title: FBHM: Functional Benchmarking and Steering of VLMs for Hateful Meme Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.31349v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hateful meme detection remains a formidable challenge for vision-language models, as existing benchmarks are structurally observational - confounding rhetorical hate mechanisms with target community features and preventing causal evaluation of model vulnerabilities. To address this, we introduce FBHM, a systematically curated benchmark of Functionality Based Hateful Memes constructed along two orthogonal axes: 25 distinct rhetorical functionalities and 10 target communities (5,000 memes total). Benchmarking state-of-the-art VLMs reveals a severe generalization gap: models highly accurate on standard datasets catastrophically drop to near-random performance on FBHM, proving they exploit dataset-specific heuristics rather than robust multimodal reasoning. To efficiently close this gap, we propose LSV (learnable steering vectors), an ultra-low data regime strategy that applies a causal intervention objective on as few as 500 steer

translated_title: FBHM：面向仇恨迷因检测的视觉语言模型功能性基准测试与引导
translated_abstract: 仇恨迷因检测对视觉语言模型而言仍然是一项艰巨的挑战，因为现有的基准在结构上是观察性的——它将仇恨的修辞机制与目标群体特征混淆在一起，从而无法对模型脆弱性进行因果评估。为了解决这一问题，我们推出了FBHM，一个系统化构建的基于功能性的仇恨迷因基准，它沿两个正交轴构建：25种不同的修辞功能和10个目标群体（共5,000个迷因）。对最先进的视觉语言模型进行基准测试揭示了一个严重的泛化差距：在标准数据集上准确率很高的模型在FBHM上灾难性地下降到接近随机的表现，证明它们利用的是数据集特定的启发式方法，而非鲁棒的多模态推理。为了高效弥合这一差距，我们提出了LSV（可学习引导向量），一种超低数据量策略，仅对少至500个引导样本施加因果干预目标……
tldr: 本文提出包含25种修辞功能和10个目标群体的仇恨迷因基准FBHM，揭示现有视觉语言模型存在严重泛化缺陷（性能降至接近随机水平），并提出仅需500个样本的可学习引导向量（LSV）方法来高效修复模型的多模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FBHM, a hateful meme benchmark with 25 rhetorical functionalities and 10 target communities that exposes near-random generalization failures in state-of-the-art VLMs, and proposes learnable steering vectors (LSV), an ultra-low data strategy using as few as 500 examples to efficiently close this gap.
